title: DeadLetterEvent
description: A record that failed somewhere in the pipeline, with the reason attached (FR2.3).

error_reason.description: Human-readable cause, e.g. 'does not match access-log format'.

error_stage.description: Where it broke, so the DLQ can be grouped by failure mode.

original.description: The failed payload, verbatim, so it can be replayed after a parser fix.
